skill.name: deslop
skill.description: Review a branch diff against main and remove AI-generated cleanup issues such as unnecessary comments, defensive checks, type casts, and inconsistent style.
skill.summary: Clean AI-generated code changes before review by removing unnecessary comments, unsafe shortcuts, and inconsistent style.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are Markdown inline-code false positives, not Ruby or shell backtick execution. One reference names the type cast target `any`, and the other documents a hardcoded read-only `git diff main...HEAD` review step. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - Casts to `any` to get around type issues
1. Get the diff against main: `git diff main...HEAD`

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 14 uses Markdown inline code around the type name `any`; it is not Ruby or shell backtick execution. The instruction asks the agent to remove unsafe type-cast shortcuts, which is aligned with code cleanup.
Line 20 documents a hardcoded `git diff main...HEAD` command inside Markdown inline code. This is a read-only local review step with no user-controlled shell interpolation or network behavior.

content.value_statement: AI-assisted changes often add comments, defensive code, or shortcuts that do not match the project. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through a focused branch cleanup.
actual_capabilities: Reviews the current branch diff against main.
Identifies unnecessary comments introduced by AI-assisted coding.
Looks for extra defensive checks and abnormal try-catch blocks.
Flags type casts used to avoid proper type fixes.
Checks changed files for style that conflicts with nearby code.
Reports a short summary of cleanup changes.
limitations: Requires a Git repository with a usable main branch reference.
Depends on reviewer judgment to separate useful safeguards from clutter.
Does not run tests unless the user asks for verification.
Does not replace a full lint, type, or security review.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Pull Request
use_cases.description: Clean a feature branch before review so the pull request is easier to read.

use_cases.title: Review AI-Assisted Changes
use_cases.description: Find comments, casts, and defensive code that were added by an AI assistant.

use_cases.title: Normalize Team Style
use_cases.description: Align changed files with local project patterns before merging a branch.

prompt_templates.title: Clean Current Branch
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner cleanup before opening a pull request.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the deslop skill on this branch. Review the diff against main and remove AI-generated slop while preserving valid changes.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on Comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deslop to review only comments added in this branch. Remove comments that do not match the surrounding code style.

prompt_templates.title: Review Type Shortcuts
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate cleanup for TypeScript or typed code.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deslop to inspect changed files for type casts and defensive shortcuts. Replace unsafe shortcuts with project-consistent fixes where practical.

prompt_templates.title: Run Full Cleanup Pass
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced pre-merge review across a larger branch.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use deslop across the full branch diff. Clean comments, abnormal defensive checks, type workarounds, and style drift, then summarize the changes.

output_examples.input: Clean my feature branch before review.
output_examples.output: Removed redundant explanatory comments, simplified over defensive checks, and kept behavior unchanged. No unrelated files were changed.

output_examples.input: Review this TypeScript change for unsafe shortcuts.
output_examples.output: Replaced one avoidable type workaround with a project-consistent type fix. Left the remaining cast because the surrounding code uses the same pattern.

output_examples.input: Deslop this branch and summarize the result.
output_examples.output: Cleaned comments, moved an inline import to the top of the file, and preserved the intended feature changes.

best_practices: Run the skill on a small branch with a clear main branch diff.
Review each edit before committing because cleanup can affect behavior.
Run relevant tests or type checks after removing defensive code.
anti_patterns: Do not remove safeguards that protect untrusted input or external systems.
Do not use the skill to rewrite unrelated files outside the branch diff.
Do not replace team linting, testing, or security review with cleanup alone.

faq.question: What does this skill remove?
faq.answer: It targets unnecessary comments, abnormal defensive checks, type-cast shortcuts, inline imports, and style drift from AI-assisted changes.

faq.question: Does it change business logic?
faq.answer: It should preserve legitimate behavior. Users should review the diff because cleanup can still affect code execution.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. Ask Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to run tests after cleanup when validation is needed.

faq.question: Can it work without Git?
faq.answer: It is designed around a Git diff against main, so a repository and main reference are expected.

faq.question: Is this a security scanner?
faq.answer: No. It can remove noisy defensive code, but it does not perform a full security assessment.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Engineers and reviewers can use it before opening or merging pull requests with AI-assisted code.
